Let $u$ and $v$ be vertices joined by an edge from $u$ to $v$, where a vertex is a source, gate or sink of the network.
The frame $D_v$ is an invertible linear operator on the space of arrays indexed by the common address set
Along the edge, the frame change $D_vD_u^{-1}$ converts the stored form at $u$ into the stored form at $v$.
anchor.note: The page defines the frame only for D_v, with v a generic vertex. The reader can infer by symmetry that D_u is the frame of the vertex u, but the page never states that D_u denotes the frame at u.
